create_metric_recorder_subclass: create a subclass of MetricRecorder that implements record_metric_values to log metrics to a custom backend
use_noop_metric_recorder: use the NOOP_METRIC_RECORDER singleton as a no-op placeholder when no metric recording is needed
record_metric_values: call record_metric_values on a MetricRecorder instance to record a category of metric values with an optional step number
implement_custom_recorder: implement a custom MetricRecorder by subclassing the abstract class and defining record_metric_values and close methods
close_metric_recorder: call close on a MetricRecorder instance to clean up resources after recording is complete
